summary.text: Venola Mason, a Democrat, represents Georgia House District 94; she won a special election runoff on April 7, 2026, and assumed office on April 18, 2026.

paragraphs.text: She earned a bachelor's degree in Spanish from Colby College in 2001 and a master's degree in education from Kennesaw State University in 2009.
She is founder and chief executive officer of AchieveIt Educational Services and has also worked at the International Center for Leadership in Education, Teach For America and Atlanta public schools.
